tool_description: Docker container monitoring, health checks, log viewing, and container management

available_commands.description: Get recent log output from a container
Get detailed health and resource usage for a container

tool_usage_guidance: Use list_containers to see all running containers
Use get_container_logs to diagnose container issues
Use get_container_health to monitor CPU and RAM usage
Use restart_container to fix unhealthy or unresponsive containers
Background monitor automatically alerts when containers go down
Requires Docker Desktop to be running
proactive_triggers: When user asks 'what containers are running?' or 'list docker'
When container is unhealthy or not responding
When user asks for logs or diagnostic info
When background monitor detects a container going down
When user needs to restart a misbehaving container

metadata.notes: Includes background monitor that alerts when containers change state. Requires Docker Desktop running.
